role: The /seed command: prints the world seed to the sender.
scope_reason: In scope since lane/idxclient: the chat takes typed input (GuiChat, the live client's T and slash), so a player types commands; the integrated server without cheats answers each (only tell, me, help and seed are allowed) and its tab completion reads the command map (csrc/engine/chatcmd.c).

members.name: getRequiredPermissionLevel
members.note: CommandShowSeed.canCommandSenderUseCommand returns MinecraftServer.isSinglePlayer() before CommandBase's permission test, and the integrated server always has an owner (isSinglePlayer true), so nothing in the client's game asks for the level

notes: lane/idxclient: commands.seed.success with the world's seed. idx-chattype-s1.
